notes.title: 📌 Feedback & Suggestions Thread (Storyline, Gameplay, BGM, UI)
notes.notes: [h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647971/5cc63412137779bd849b07ddc15e1da5e2a00b91.jpg"][/img][/h1][h1][b]📝 What kind of feedback or ideas do you have for the game?[/b][/h1][h1][/h1][p]🎭 [b]Storyline[/b] → What story directions would you like to see? What types of characters do you enjoy? Are there any specific scenes you’re hoping for?[/p][p][/p][p]🎮 [b]Gameplay[/b] → Thoughts on interaction frequency, branching design, exploration elements, etc.?[/p][p][/p][p]🎵 [b]BGM / Sound Effects[/b] → What style of music do you prefer? More cinematic or more gentle and immersive?[/p][p][/p][p]🎨 [b]UI Design[/b] → Any interface details you think could be improved, or features you’d like to see added?[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]📢 Suggested comment format[/b] [i](but feel free to write however you like!)[/i][/p][p][/p][p]【Story Suggestions】xxx[/p][p]【Gameplay Suggestions】xxx[/p][p]【BGM / UI Suggestions】xxx[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]🙏 I’ll carefully read every suggestion — and if we adopt any of your ideas, we’ll do our best to implement them! Sometimes we may even give shoutouts in future dev logs to thank contributors![/p][p][/p][p]Looking forward to everyone’s feedback — let’s make [i]Travel Diary[/i] even better together![/p]

notes.title: Dev Log Vol.1: Current Progress & Behind-the-Scenes Stories
notes.notes: [h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647971/3ff4cf5ba04e5b1aac1570aa9ba8d1f13ad9c366.jpg"][/img]🎮 [b]Current Development Progress[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]The overall framework and main storyline are mostly in place. Currently working on:[/p][p][/p][p]✅ Optimizing scene art & character visuals (still tackling AI consistency issues…)[/p][p][/p][p]✅ Fine-tuning UI for a more cinematic style[/p][p][/p][p]✅ Partial BGM / sound effects completed, still polishing[/p][p][/p][p]✅ Internal testing of storyline branches in progress, debugging branching logic continuously[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]🎬 [b]Behind the Scenes[/b][/p][p][/p][p]One big challenge this time has been the consistency of AI-generated characters…[/p][p]Different angles often break the visuals, outfits and accessories needed lots of rework, and the UI design has gone through several revisions. The smoother part so far has been working on the BGM — emo~[/p][p][/p][p]Still, seeing steady progress is quite motivating. Curious to see how it will all feel once finished.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]📝 [b]Next Steps[/b][/p][p][/p][p]The next focus will be on refining visuals and polishing the narrative content for each ending.[/p][p]UI and sound design will also continue to be improved.[/p][p][/p][p]If you have any ideas for gameplay or story you’d like to see, feel free to leave a comment in the discussion section — I’ll be reading every one of them![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Thank you for following [i]Travel Diary[/i]![/p][p]See you in the next dev log~![/p]
